caseName: Florida ex rel. Hawkins v. Board of Control
caseNameFull: Florida ex rel. Hawkins v. Board of Control
attorneys: Robert L. Garter and Thurgood Marshall for petitioner. Richard W. Ervin, Attorney-General of Florida, Ralph E. Odum and John J. Blair, Assistant Attorneys General, and Wilson W. Wright, Special Assistant Attorney General, for respondents.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Florida denied without prejudice to the petitioner’s seeking relief in an appropriate United States District Court.
